title: Syrian-Style Roasted Bulgur Pilaf
description: A flavorful and nutritious Syrian-inspired pilaf made with roasted bulgur and a blend of spices.
instructions: Toss the bulgur with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, onion, garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper on a baking sheet.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the bulgur is lightly toasted and fragrant.
Fluff the roasted bulgur with a fork and stir in the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil.
Transfer the bulgur mixture to a medium saucepan and add 2 cups of water.
Bring to a boil over high heat, then reduce the heat to low and cover.
Simmer for 10-12 minutes, or until the water has been absorbed and the bulgur is tender.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and stir in chopped parsley, if using.
